description.value: Quesada is a Canadian fast-casual Mexican chain that has been serving burritos, tacos, quesadillas, and bowls since 2004, with this location situated in the Willoughby Town Centre shopping area of Langley Township. The restaurant is part of the Foodtastic franchise network and is known for daily hand-mashed guacamole and a customizable menu inspired by regional Mexican flavours. It is a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the Willoughby corridor, with takeout readily available.
